about: Where each operational role the deployer holds belongs. A job's wallet is <JOB>_ADDRESS in env (credit-operator → CREDIT_OPERATOR_ADDRESS); "safe" is SAFE_ADDRESS; "renounce" is used by nothing off-chain. Mapped 2026-10-23 from apps/api and contracts/; see docs/command-reference/DECISIONS.md, "Moving the operational roles". Updated 2026-11-15 for the audit: the vault's relayer holds RELAYER_ROLE, not OPERATOR_ROLE (audit H-3, Phase 1B; PHASE-2D-REPORT §7); nothing borrows from the LendingPool any more (decision 17), so its BORROWER_ROLE is mapped to no one and deploy/27_wire_Earn.ts revokes it; the Earn roles (the pool's DEPLOYER/VALUATION/SUSPENSION/CCO/TREASURER, EarnControls') are granted from deploy/config/earn-roles.json, not here.
walletsAbout: Wallets known from the chain, used when env names none: the card settler is the one RevolvingIssuer approved (CardSettlerUpdated, block 46997232).
